title: A dynamic cathode interlayer for ultralow self-discharge and high iodide utilization in zinc–iodine batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05584E, Paper

Junming Kang, Jiajia Zhang, Wang Wan, Zhimin Zhai, Ganxiong Liu, Ying Ge, Lequan Wang, Chao Wang, Hongbin Lu
TMA+ cations enhance Zn plating behavior and capture polyiodides to form a dynamic cathode interlayer, which suppresses the polyiodide dissolution and involves them back into redox reaction.
